tools.description:
Use this to run a structured quality gate from presets, commands, and policy scans.

    `repo` sets the default sub-repository for policy-scan checks in a
    polyrepo workspace; an individual check can override it with its own `repo` key.

checks.description: Ordered checks. Each item uses preset or command, plus optional id, required, timeout_ms, parse_kind, repo.
checks.title: Checks

stop_on_failure.description: When true, stop after the first failed required check.

repo.description: Optional path to a sub-repository in a polyrepo workspace (as returned by list_repos). Defaults to the workspace root's own git repository, if any.
repo.title: Repo

tools.name: run_test_preset
tools.description:
Use this when you need to run a stack-autodetected or named test/lint/build preset without sending a long command string.

    `cwd` is a convenience for the bare action-name form: passing
    `preset="test", cwd="api-gateway"` is equivalent to `preset="api-gateway:test"`.
    It is ignored when `preset` already uses the composite `service:action` syntax
    or names an explicit profile preset.

preset.description: Preset to run: an action name (test, lint, typecheck, format, build) resolved for the workspace root or the given cwd; a composite 'service/path:action' to resolve it for a polyrepo sub-directory (autodetected via go.mod/pyproject.toml/package.json/Cargo.toml/Makefile, see list_repos/list_test_presets); or a named preset key from .chatrepo/mcp.yml or the generic built-ins: git_diff_check, node_version, npm_version.
preset.title: Preset

timeout_ms.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds, capped by server configuration.
timeout_ms.title: Timeout Ms

tail_lines.description: Number of trailing stdout/stderr lines to include in command results. Use null to omit tails.
tail_lines.title: Tail Lines

background.description: When true, start the preset as a background job and poll it later.
background.title: Background

cwd.description: Optional repository-relative working directory. Defaults to the repository root.
cwd.title: Cwd
